fields.label: Tour Theme
fields.name: tour_theme
fields.instructions: Choose the Tour Theme, default is Paprika.

fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.instructions: Add the Title only i.e. Tofino: Tasting Trail. The Location will be combined with this field.

fields.label: Tour Features
fields.name: tour_features
fields.instructions: Add features of this Tour. This "features" act as a tag line. i.e. 'Drink, Eat, Relax'.

fields.label: Tour Discriptor
fields.name: tour_discriptor
fields.instructions: This is used on a Tour card on the Tours page, or on the Featured Block card for featured tours.

fields.label: Location Disclaimer
fields.message:
Remember to add a Location taxonomy in the sidebar.

Max 1 Location per Tour.

fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: short_description
fields.instructions: Add a short description of this experience (Max 300 Characters).

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: badge_title
sub_fields.instructions: Add an optional title for this badge section.

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: badge_content
sub_fields.instructions: Add optional context or description alongside the badge.

sub_fields.label: Badge Image
sub_fields.name: badge_image
sub_fields.instructions: Upload the badge or logo image.

sub_fields.label: Badge Link
sub_fields.name: badge_url
sub_fields.instructions: Add the URL and link text for this badge. The link text will appear as a clickable label beneath the badge image. If left blank, it will default to 'Learn more about [Tour Title]'.

fields.label: Duration
fields.name: duration
fields.instructions: Set the duration of the experience.

fields.label: Flexible Time?
fields.name: flexible_time_toggle
fields.instructions: Choose between a Flexible Time Label or a time stamped time for the tour Start Time.

fields.label: Flexible Time Label
fields.name: flexible_time_label
fields.instructions: Please use only one word for the Flexible Time Label.

fields.label: Start Time
fields.name: start_time
fields.instructions: Select a start time for the tour.

fields.label: Dates
fields.name: dates
fields.instructions: Provide information on Tour dates i.e. Wednesday to Sunday

fields.label: Cost Type?
fields.name: cost_type_toggle
fields.instructions: Choose between a starting price, or a text message about starting cost.

fields.label: Starting Cost (Price)
fields.name: starting_cost
fields.instructions: Set a "starting from" cost.

fields.label: Starting Cost (Text)
fields.name: starting_cost_text
fields.instructions: Display a text message about starting costs.

fields.label: Experience Type
fields.name: tour_type
fields.instructions: Choose the Tour Type to be displayed in the information area on the Tour page.

fields.label: Details
fields.name: details
fields.instructions: Add text details here (heading and content).

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: content
sub_fields.instructions: Add text only. HTML code is also fine if you are confident in what you are adding (no images or other media here).

fields.label: FAQs?
fields.name: faqs_toggle
fields.instructions: Turn FAQs 'On' or 'Off'

fields.label: Booking Type?
fields.name: booking_type_toggle
fields.instructions: Choose between a Chef Option or the Tours Options for the Booking Options Type.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading_booking
fields.instructions: Add the booking section's Heading.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.name: subheading_booking
fields.instructions: Add a optional subheading (Max 300 characters). If it is left empty it will simply not appear.

fields.label: Chef Hosted URL
fields.name: digitally_guided_url
fields.instructions: Add the Digitally Guided URL

fields.label: Experience Bookings Options
fields.name: various_bookings_options
fields.instructions: Add each booking option that is included with this tour here. There is a Max of 1 for each tour option.

sub_fields.label: Private URL
sub_fields.name: private_guided_url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the FareHarbor booking URL here.

sub_fields.label: Private Off Season
sub_fields.name: private_guided_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle buttons booking buttons on or off depending on the season.

sub_fields.label: Signature Itinerary Experience Option
sub_fields.message: This is the default booking option and must always accompany a Experience that uses the Experience Options booking type.

sub_fields.label: Signature Itinerary URL
sub_fields.name: digitally_guided_url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the FareHarbor booking URL here.

sub_fields.label: Signature Itinerary Off Season
sub_fields.name: digitally_guided_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle booking button on or off depending on the season.

sub_fields.label: Hosted URL
sub_fields.name: vip_guided_url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the FareHarbor booking URL here.

sub_fields.label: Hosted Off Season
sub_fields.name: vip_guided_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle buttons booking buttons on or off depending on the season.

sub_fields.label: E-Bike URL
sub_fields.name: ebike_guided_url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the FareHarbor booking URL here.

sub_fields.label: E-Bike Off Season
sub_fields.name: ebike_guided_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle booking button on or off depending on the season.

sub_fields.label: Chauffeured Off Season
sub_fields.name: chauffeur_guided_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle booking button on or off depending on the season.

sub_fields.label: By Request Option
sub_fields.message: This is the By Request booking option type for experiences.

sub_fields.label: Request Form
sub_fields.message: Request Form Options. This will appear below the booking options on the single experience page if a contact form [short_code] is added.

sub_fields.label: Group Experience Option
sub_fields.message: This is the group booking option type for experiences.

sub_fields.label: Group Off Season
sub_fields.name: group_off_season
sub_fields.instructions: Toggle booking button on or off depending on the season.

fields.label: Hero Button Override
fields.name: hero_button_override
fields.instructions: You can override the 'CHOOSE YOUR EXPERIENCE' button in the hero and have the 'HOSTED' etc. button instead. It is advised to only use this override when there is a single booking type. If there are more than 1 type below, leave this off.

fields.label: Gallery?
fields.name: gallery_toggle
fields.instructions: Turn the Gallery 'On' or 'Off'

fields.label: Tour Gallery
fields.name: tour_gallery
fields.instructions: Add between 1 and 12 images to show off a Tour in a rotating Gallery.

fields.label: Vendors?
fields.name: vendors_toggle
fields.instructions: Turn Vendors 'On' or 'Off'

fields.label: Vendors On
fields.message: The vendors for this Tour are turned 'On' and will automatically be displayed on the Tour page. If you would like to add vendors to this tour, go to Tours > All Vendor in the WordPress sidebar to add a new vendor.

fields.label: Vendors Off
fields.message: The Vendors for this Tour are turned 'Off' and will not be displayed on the Tour page.

fields.label: Vendor Info
fields.name: vendor_info
fields.default_value: Vendors subject to change based on date and time of year.

fields.label: Testimonials?
fields.name: testimonials_toggle
fields.instructions: Turn Testimonials 'On' or 'Off'

fields.label: Testimonials On
fields.message: The testimonials for this Tour are turned 'On' and will automatically be displayed on the Tour page. If you would like to add testimonials to this tour, go to Tours > All Testimonials in the WordPress sidebar to add a new testimonial.

fields.label: Testimonials Off
fields.message: The Testimonials for this Tour are turned 'Off' and will not be displayed on the Tour page.

fields.label: Group Info?
fields.name: group_info_toggle
fields.instructions: Toggle Group information 'On' or 'Off'.

fields.label: Content
fields.name: content
fields.default_value: Our boutique-style tours offer the smallest group sizes in the industry, ensuring a personalized and intimate experience. However, if you're looking to organize a larger group than what we offer in our standard package, we can accommodate your needs upon request. We understand that planning the perfect adventure for a larger group can be daunting. That's why we take care of everything for you. Simply show up and indulge in the journey, knowing we've meticulously planned every detail for your enjoyment. Inquire below to learn more about our larger group tour options.

fields.label: Schema Offers
fields.name: schema_offers
fields.instructions: Add each bookable offer for this experience. Used in Product schema markup. If left empty, the system will use the starting cost as a single offer.

fields.label: Has Specific Event Dates?
fields.name: schema_events_toggle
fields.instructions: Enable this for experiences with specific scheduled public dates (e.g. Rooted). This will generate Event schema for each date.

fields.label: Event Dates
fields.name: schema_events
fields.instructions: Add each scheduled public date for this experience.

fields.label: Event Location
fields.name: schema_event_location
fields.instructions: Venue and address details for Event schema.

fields.label: Performer / Host Name
fields.name: schema_performer
fields.instructions: Name of the person leading the event (used in Event schema).
